text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You. It seems today is your birthday. 
Continue to stay in good health, and 
strive even harder from here on.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: What is it? Why the surprised look?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Well, uh... I just didn't expect you to 
celebrate for me. You actually 
remembered... my birthday.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. Very well, consider it a king's alms 
for a commoner's auspicious day. Receive 
it with reverence.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Umm, well... Thank you for the birthday 
wishes.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep striving to stay fit and well. 
...Though, not just as your subject... 
but—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
A fine spirit. Show this King how you 
intend to entertain me.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Right on. ...I'll give 'em a good show, 
and then leave 'em eating my dust, su...!
